svg.title: Linear regression is a poor classifier
svg.desc: Benign tumours at y = 0 and malignant ones at y = 1, with one extra malignant tumour far to the right. The least-squares line fitted with that example is flatter than the one fitted without it, and the size where it crosses 0.5 moves right past several malignant tumours. The logistic regression curve fitted with the extra example keeps its boundary between the classes.
